description: This PHP source file defines SOAP web service endpoints for the SuiteCRM system, including functions to retrieve modified relationship records, entries, and attendee lists, with associated registration code for SOAP server. It handles authentication validation, module access checks, and data serialization in XML/base64 encoding.

classes.name: SoapError
classes.description: Class used to handle and structure SOAP error responses.

methods.name: sync_get_modified_relationships
methods.description: Retrieves a list of relationship records modified within a date range, used for syncing with mobile clients.

methods.name: get_modified_entries
methods.description: Fetches modified entries of a specified module given a list of record IDs.

methods.name: get_attendee_list
methods.description: Returns attendee information for Meeting or Call modules, including associated user and contact details.
